ios.desc:
McAfee Security protects smartphones, tablets, Macs, and PCs with robust data protection features, bank-grade VPN encryption, and breach monitoring for your personal info. 

Stay safer than safe with McAfee, a trusted name in online and mobile security. 

THREAT DETECTION: 

SCAM DETECTOR 
 ▪ Flags risky messages and blocks harmful sites for you, even if you accidentally click. 
 ▪ Identifies suspicious emails before you open them and guides you on what to do next. We’ll even explain the danger, so you know what to watch out for. 

SECURE CONNECTION: 

SECURE VPN 
 ▪ Keeps personal data and locations private with bank-grade Wi-Fi VPN encryption. 
 ▪ Defends your mobile devices against unsecured public Wi-Fi hotspots. 
 ▪ Connects to different countries and change your location & IP address*. 

SMART SCAN 
 ▪ Scan your device and your personal information for issues. Get guidance to fix problems, quickly and easily. 

WI-FI SCAN 
 ▪ Wi-Fi scan analyzes networks for security risks and ensures a safer online connection. 

SAFE BROWSING 
 ▪ Blocks malicious websites automatically so you can browse safely. 

DATA PROTECTION: 

IDENTITY MONITORING 
 ▪ Scans and monitors online personal data for security breaches. 
 ▪ Receive alerts and secure your info quickly with our protection tips. 
 ▪ Monitors up to 10 email addresses, ID numbers, passport numbers, bank cards*. 

TRANSACTION & CREDIT MONITORING 
 ▪ Protect yourself from financial fraud and stay on top of your bank and credit card transactions. 
 ▪ Monitor your credit to keep track of changes to your credit score and catch unauthorized activity. 

SOCIAL PRIVACY MANAGER 
 ▪ Adjusts 100+ privacy settings across your social media accounts in just a few clicks. 

PERSONAL DATA CLEANUP 
 ▪ We'll tell you if sites are selling your information, guide you on what to do next, and can even handle it for you. 

ONLINE ACCOUNT CLEANUP 
 ▪ McAfee reduces your exposure to data breaches by finding old or unused online accounts and guiding through next steps. We can even delete them for you. 

IDENTITY THEFT COVERAGE AND RESTORATION 
▪ You’re backed by $1M identity theft coverage and restoration support from a licensed professional, just in case. 

PLANS AND SUBSCRIPTIONS

 ▪ System Scan

 ▪ Basic Identity Monitoring*
